summary: F2 is fixed. With a missing, None or empty session_id, nothing is recorded anywhere, and reopenable guards a falsy session. Most of F1 is fixed: a session's open bound run now gets the cost binding and the reviewer stop (P2c), a verified run never gets a stop, and in the real review flow the stop follows the newest checkout. One part of F1 remains. When the session has an earlier closed run, a run started inside the turn still gets no cost binding, and without a checkout its reviewer stop goes to the old run (P2d). That case falls outside the stated acceptance rows. Full tests/core passes (165 tests), and so do the 7 subagent tests. F2 was re-checked with P2a, P2b and the RF2 regression (session_id empty string) and is closed, so it is not listed.

findings.title: Partly fixed: a run started inside the turn still gets no cost binding when the session has an earlier closed run
findings.evidence: scripts/cvcore/hooks.py:148-151 calls _attach only when `bound or own is None`. In P2d, s1 has an old incomplete run, so reopenable returns it. The new unbound run started inside the turn is `live` and is skipped. Probe output: 'P2d builder stop: new run sessions=[] usage={}'. Without a checkout, the reviewer stop also goes to the old run, because the key's tie-breaker `r is own or bound` favours own: 'P2d reviewer stop: new run stops=[] old run stops=[rev-for-new]'. In the real flow, where the new run has a checkout, the stop lands correctly (RF1a: new stops=['rev']), but the cost is still not bound (new usage=False). Fixed cases: P2c (the open bound run gets usage and the stop), RF1b (the stop never lands on s2's run, even when s2's checkout is newer), RF1c (never on a verified run). The skip looks deliberate, to avoid claiming an unbound run that may belong to another session. That trade-off means 8bae3e2's in-turn cost is lost whenever the session already has an incomplete or failed run.

findings.recommendation: Also bind `live` when the session's own run is closed (own.get('outcome') is not None) and live was created after it: `own is None or (own.get('outcome') and str(live.get('created_at','')) > str(own.get('created_at','')))`. Or accept the trade-off and document it in a comment. Add a P2d test either way.
